tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.immovable_rod: Press the button and it stops where it is, however hard it is pushed. Use it on a face or in the air to set it; crouch and use it to take it back.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.climbing_rope: Throw it at a wall and the rope runs up it, a rope's length, and hangs for three minutes. It rests a while after.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.endless_jug: Never empty. Fills a cauldron, soaks farmland, puts out fires and fills a bucket in your other hand. Drink from it to stop a burn.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.floating_light: Use it and the spark leaves the glass and follows you; use it again and it comes home.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.stone_hound: Set it down and it wakes as a great hound at your side for ten minutes, once a day. Then it is stone again.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.breaking_horn: Sound it and the rock ahead breaks in a tunnel three across and ten deep. Not locked things, not another realm's land.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.smoke_bottle: Unstopper it and a bank of fog pours out round you. It is never empty, and rests a minute between uses.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.deck_of_fates: Draw one to three cards. What you draw happens, and the deck is gone with the last.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.deck_of_fates.war: Some of the cards are very bad.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.keep_deed: Use it on open ground, away from other realms, and a keep rises with its servants and you on the throne.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.wand_of_embe: A bolt of fire flies from it and sets alight what it hits.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.wand_of_fros: A breath of cold that slows and chills what it touches.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.wand_of_mend: Closes the wounds of whoever you aim it at, or yours.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.wand_of_bind: Holds what it points at fast for a few breaths, unless it shrugs it off.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.staff_of_gal: A great wind that throws everything near you outward.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.staff_of_war: A ward settles on you and those close by, a cushion against the next blows.
tooltip.jaymoskingdoms.wand.dawn: Fills again at dawn. Use the last and it may crumble.
gadget.jaymoskingdoms.hound.name: Stone Hound
gadget.jaymoskingdoms.hound.rests: The hound sleeps in its stone until the next dawn.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.unknown: Its powers are not known yet. Use it a while, or have a wizard or a sage look at it.
curse.jaymoskingdoms.priest: That thing clings to you. I can lift it, for a price.
curse.jaymoskingdoms.lifted: It is done. Put it down, or keep it, as you will.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.curse.whisper.alon: ...no one. There is no one near. Go and find them...
speech.jaymoskingdoms.curse.whisper.far: ...%s is far away. Far to the %s...
research.jaymoskingdoms.found.learned: You have studied %s and know what it does.
research.jaymoskingdoms.found.gone: You carry nothing that is not yet known.
unknown.jaymoskingdoms.wizard: You carry something with a power on it that you do not know. I could tell you, for a fee.
unknown.jaymoskingdoms.told: Ah. This is %s. Now you know what it does.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.ask: A thin deck of painted cards in a black box. How many will you draw? Whatever comes happens, and the deck is gone with the last.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.jester: The Jester grins. Two more cards are yours to draw.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.throne.built: A keep rises and its servants kneel. The Kingdom of %s is yours.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.throne.deed: The land will not bear a keep here. A deed is left in your hand: use it on open ground, far from other realms.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.deed.crowded: Another realm's land is too near. Take the deed farther off.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.nemesis.sent: Someone has sent a hunter after you.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.nemesis.name: Hunter
deck.jaymoskingdoms.nemesis.fell: A hunter falls. %s more will come.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.nemesis.over: The last hunter falls. No one sends more.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.wish.ask: The Star is yours. What do you wish for?
deck.jaymoskingdoms.wish.life: A longer life (five more hearts, for good)
deck.jaymoskingdoms.wish.mercy: The mercy of the nearest realm
deck.jaymoskingdoms.mind.now: Your mind turns and you are now a %s.
deck.jaymoskingdoms.knight.name: Death Knight
deck.jaymoskingdoms.knight.won: The knight falls, and leaves something behind.
potion.jaymoskingdoms.clash.cancel: The two draughts fight and cancel each other.
potion.jaymoskingdoms.clash.double: The two draughts feed each other: both last twice as long.
potion.jaymoskingdoms.clash.belly: The draughts burst in your belly.
will.jaymoskingdoms.purpose.weak: the weak spared and the strong cut
%s hums against your hand: There are dead who do not lie still. I know where they walk.
%s: At last. A hand that knows what I am for.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.undead.idle.0: %s: The graves are quiet near here. I do not trust it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.undead.idle.1: %s: Cold in the air. Is that the dead, or only a draught?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.undead.idle.2: %s: Show me bones, and I will show you an edge.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.undead.please: %s: It will not rise again. Another.
%s: Why are you sheathing me when the dead are in the world?
%s: You carry me past a grave and say nothing? Fight, or let me.
%s: I will not be quiet while the dead walk.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.undead.held_o: %s: You held me back. I will remember that.
%s: Enough. I will do it myself.
%s slides out of your grip and lies on the ground, cold.
%s will not be held. It falls.
%s: I am only a sword, and you wield me badly.
%s says nothing, and the nothing is cold.
%s: The dead are put down for now. Rest.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.hello.0: %s: Strike down the proud. Keep your hand from the helpless. Is that so hard?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.hello.1: %s: You are new to me. Let us see what you spare.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.idle.0: %s: A sword should be kind where it can be.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.idle.1: %s: I smell armour, and I smell fear. They are not the same.
%s: That one could fight back. Good.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.argue.0: %s: That was a defenceless thing. Do not do that again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.argue.1: %s: You strike the small and I grow heavy.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.held_off: %s: Thank you for letting them go.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.takes.0: %s: You will not hurt the weak while I am in your hand.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.slips.0: %s turns in your grip and drops away from you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.slips.1: %s would rather lie in the dirt than do that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.weak.sulks.0: %s: I am ashamed, and I do not forget.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.hello.0: %s: Gold. I smell it. Is there any about?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.hello.1: %s: Do not leave me poor, friend.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.idle.0: %s: A coin or two would not hurt.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.idle.1: %s: Do you hear that? A purse, somewhere.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.idle.2: %s: Sing me a song of silver.
%s: Gold is a warm thing. More.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.argue.1: %s: Your purse is lighter and so is my mood.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.argue.2: %s: Every coin you lose, I feel.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.held_off: %s: You kept the coin. I will let it go.
%s: Fine. But I am watching the purse.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.takes.0: %s: Hand it over. I will find us some.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.takes.1: %s: I will count the coin myself.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.slips.0: %s will not be carried by a poor man. It drops.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.will.gold.sated.0: %s: A fat purse is a fine thing.
